LanguageData.RimGram_RvLaunch_0: Engines hot, hatches sealed. {COLONY_name} is leaving orbit. Wave if you can see us.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvLaunch_1: Next stop: {EXTRA}. Snacks packed, nerves not.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvLaunch_2: Warp countdown. If this is my last post, the cat food is in the second locker.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvLaunch_3: Course set for {EXTRA}. The captain says it's 'perfectly safe'. The captain says that a lot.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvLaunch_4: Watching the planet shrink in the window. Weird how home looks so small from here.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvLaunch_5: Strapped in, praying to every engineer who ever touched this hull.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvArrive_0: We made it! {EXTRA}, you are gorgeous.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvArrive_1: Dropped out of warp in {EXTRA}. Everyone still has the right number of limbs.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvArrive_2: Arrival confirmed. The coffee survived. The coffee always survives.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvArrive_3: New sky outside the porthole. I'll never get used to this.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvArrive_4: Hull integrity: fine. Crew integrity: questionable. Welcome to {EXTRA}.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvNewSystem_0: First humans in {EXTRA}? Maybe. First ones to post about it? Definitely.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvNewSystem_1: Charted a new system today: {EXTRA}. Naming rights go to whoever cleans the toilets this week.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvNewSystem_2: The star here is a different colour. The photos don't do it justice.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvNewSystem_3: Somewhere out there, a cartographer just felt a disturbance. {EXTRA} is on the map now.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvNewSystem_4: New system, new rocks, new chances to be eaten by something. Exploration!
LanguageData.RimGram_RvStrangerWelcome_0: Welcome to {EXTRA}, travellers. Fuel is overpriced and the bar is worse.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvStrangerWelcome_1: New ship on the scopes. Hi, {COLONY_name}. Please don't shoot the ore haulers.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvStrangerWelcome_2: Locals of {EXTRA} say hello. Some of them say other things too.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvStrangerWelcome_3: Saw {COLONY_name} drop in. Nice hull. Shame about the paint.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvCivFall_0: BREAKING: {EXTRA} has collapsed. Their last broadcast was static.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvCivFall_1: {EXTRA} is gone. Refugee ships are already appearing on the lanes.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvCivFall_2: History closes a chapter today. {EXTRA} no longer exists as a state.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvCivFall_3: Markets crash as {EXTRA} falls. Scavengers are rejoicing.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvRumorFall_0: Unconfirmed: a whole civilization went silent somewhere past the frontier.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvRumorFall_1: Traders talk of empty worlds and dead relays out in the dark.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvRumorFall_2: A distant power has fallen. Nobody knows its name. Nobody will.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Imperial_0: By decree of the throne, we acknowledge {COLONY_name}. Kneel optional. For now.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Imperial_1: The Crown notes your arrival, {COLONY_name}. Bring tribute and good manners.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Imperial_2: Our heralds have recorded your name, {COLONY_name}. Do not make us regret it.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Holy_0: The Light has guided {COLONY_name} to us. Blessed be the voyage.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Holy_1: Pilgrims, welcome. {COLONY_name} is now in our prayers. Whether you like it or not.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Holy_2: The stars foretold your coming, {COLONY_name}. They also foretold you'd be late.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Republic_0: The Assembly welcomes {COLONY_name}. A committee has been formed to decide how warmly.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Republic_1: Hello {COLONY_name}! Our citizens voted to say hi. 52 to 48.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Republic_2: Open borders, open markets, open minds. Welcome, {COLONY_name}.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Merchant_0: New customer detected: {COLONY_name}. Our catalogue is attached. Prices negotiable, fees are not.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Merchant_1: {COLONY_name}! Welcome to the market. First trade gets a free logo sticker.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Merchant_2: Every new contact is an opportunity. Hi {COLONY_name}, what are you buying?
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Martial_0: Contact logged: {COLONY_name}. Threat level under review. Stay in your lane.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Martial_1: Our fleet has seen you, {COLONY_name}. Our fleet sees everything.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Martial_2: Welcome. Weapons cold, please. Ours are always warm.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Hive_0: NEW NODE OBSERVED: {COLONY_name}. CURIOSITY RISING. GREETINGS.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Hive_1: We are many. You are few. We say hello in unison, {COLONY_name}.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Hive_2: Signal received. Signal parsed. Signal appreciated. Welcome, {COLONY_name}.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Glitter_0: Oh, a little rimworld ship! How charming. Welcome, {COLONY_name}.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Glitter_1: Our children study ships like yours in history class. Welcome, {COLONY_name}!
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Glitter_2: Do you need anything, {COLONY_name}? Medicine? A hull that doesn't leak?
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Frontier_0: Another ship out here? Huh. Hi, {COLONY_name}. Got spare parts?
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Frontier_1: Out on the frontier everybody's a neighbour. Welcome, {COLONY_name}.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Frontier_2: Saw your drive flare from three moons away, {COLONY_name}. Come by for stew.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Pirate_0: Well well, fresh meat. Hi {COLONY_name}. Nice cargo you probably have.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Pirate_1: {COLONY_name}, huh? We'll remember that name. For targeting purposes.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFirstContact_Pirate_2: New ship on the lanes. Lads, sharpen the boarding axes.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvRumorCiv_0: Strange lights past the edge of the charts. Somebody big lives out there.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvRumorCiv_1: Picked up a broadcast in a language nobody here speaks. Creepy or exciting? Both.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvRumorCiv_2: They say there's an empire out past the nebula. They say a lot of things.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvRumorCiv_3: An unknown fleet crossed our relay last night. No hails. No names.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvWarOnPlayer_0: {COLONY_name} has chosen war. So be it.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvWarOnPlayer_1: To {COLONY_name}: our fleets are moving. Enjoy your last quiet week.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvWarOnPlayer_2: We have declared {COLONY_name} an enemy of {FACTION_name}. Spread the word.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvWarOnPlayer_3: Diplomacy failed. Engineers, load the torpedoes.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvPlayerWar_0: WAR: {COLONY_name} and {EXTRA} are now in open conflict.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvPlayerWar_1: Shipping lanes near {COLONY_name} declared unsafe as war with {EXTRA} begins.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvPlayerWar_2: Analysts give {COLONY_name} a 30% chance against {EXTRA}. Analysts have been wrong before.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvPeaceWithPlayer_1: The guns go quiet. To {COLONY_name}: well fought.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvPeaceWithPlayer_2: Treaty signed with {COLONY_name}. Our historians will call it a victory either way.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvCivWar_0: WAR DECLARED: {EXTRA}. Traders advised to avoid the border.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvCivWar_2: Another war in the sector: {EXTRA}. Refugee relays on standby.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvCivWarDeclare_0: {TARGETFACTION_name} has pushed us too far. War it is.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvRumorWar_0: Unconfirmed reports: {EXTRA} is at war with someone nobody has heard of.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvRumorWar_1: Wreckage drifting from beyond the charts. {EXTRA} fleets were seen heading there.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvCivPeace_0: PEACE: {EXTRA} have signed a treaty. Insurance rates drop.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvCivPeace_1: The war is over: {EXTRA}. Scrap dealers are devastated.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvColonyTaken_0: {COLONY_name} has seized {EXTRA}. New flags are going up.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvColonyFounded_0: We founded {EXTRA} today! Population: small. Hopes: huge.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvColonyFounded_1: Planted the flag at {EXTRA}. Somebody please water the flag.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvColonyFounded_2: {EXTRA} is officially a colony of {COLONY_name}. I cried a little. Maybe a lot.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvColonyFounded_3: New home unlocked: {EXTRA}. First rule: we don't talk about the landing.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvAnomaly_0: Sensors picked up something weird: {EXTRA}. Science team is either thrilled or terrified.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvAnomaly_1: Found a {EXTRA} out here. I am not touching it. Somebody else touch it.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvAnomaly_2: Our researcher hasn't slept since we found the {EXTRA}. Neither have I, but for different reasons.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvAnomaly_3: The universe is strange and today it proved it. #{EXTRA}
LanguageData.RimGram_RvCouncil_1: The Council has spoken. '{EXTRA}' is now law across member worlds.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFlow_Harmony_0: Something woke up inside me today. It feels like… music I can almost hear.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFlow_Harmony_1: I moved a cup without touching it. I'm choosing to stay calm about this.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFlow_Harmony_2: The Flow is real. And it's warm. #Harmony
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFlow_Rupture_0: I can feel everyone's fear on this ship. I like it more than I should.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFlow_Rupture_1: Something broke open inside me. It's loud. It's angry. It's mine.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvFlow_Rupture_2: The Flow answers to strength. Lucky me. #Rupture
LanguageData.RimGram_RvSpaceLife_0: Day 100 without gravity. My hair has achieved independence.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvSpaceLife_1: Window view today: infinite darkness and one suspicious asteroid.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvSpaceLife_2: Miss the smell of rain. The recycled air smells like feet and ambition.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvSpaceLife_3: Cryopod check: still cold, still creepy, still not sleeping in one.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvSpaceLife_4: Galley served 'nutrient loaf' again. It was served with confidence.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvSpaceLife_5: EVA selfie! The visor reflection makes me look heroic. I was fixing a toilet vent.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvSpaceLife_6: Someone set the airlock playlist to dramatic music. I approve.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvSpaceLife_7: Ship life tip: never ask the engineer what that noise was.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvSpaceLife_8: Looked at the stars for an hour today. They didn't look back. Rude.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvSpaceLife_9: Hydroponics bay smells like a forest if you close your eyes and lie to yourself.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvStrangerChatter_0: Asteroid miner update: found nickel, iron, and one very angry space bug.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvStrangerChatter_1: Selling slightly used reactor parts. Glow is normal. Probably.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvStrangerChatter_2: Pilgrimage day 40. The holy relay is still 300 light years away. Faith!
LanguageData.RimGram_RvStrangerChatter_3: Bounty board is full this week. If you see a man with a golden eyepatch, call me.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvStrangerChatter_4: Customs officer at the jump gate asked if I had 'anything to declare'. I declared my sadness.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvStrangerChatter_5: Hauling ice across the belt. 6 months alone. I've started naming the crates.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvStrangerChatter_6: Rumour on the station: someone found an archotech fragment. Rumour on the station: someone always does.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvStrangerChatter_7: Docking fees went up again. Space is free, parking is not.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Imperial_0: The Emperor's birthday parade went beautifully. Attendance was mandatory and joyful.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Imperial_1: New noble titles available. Inquire with your nearest herald. Bring silver.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Imperial_2: Order is peace. Peace is order. The Throne thanks you for your obedience.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Imperial_3: Today our fleets saluted the Crown in perfect formation. Glory to {FACTION_name}.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Holy_0: Daily reminder: the stars are listening. Behave.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Holy_1: Our temple ship completed its 1000th orbit of prayer.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Holy_2: Doubt is a cold vacuum. Faith is a warm hull.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Holy_3: Pilgrims welcome. Heretics also welcome, for different activities.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Republic_0: Election season! Please stop sending candidate holograms to children.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Republic_1: The Senate debated for 14 hours. Outcome: another debate.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Republic_2: Free speech, free trade, free coffee on Fridays. That's {FACTION_name}.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Republic_3: New infrastructure bill passed. The space road will be ready in only 40 years.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Merchant_0: Quarterly profits up 12%. Morale up 0%. Investors delighted.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Merchant_1: Limited offer: buy one shuttle, get the second at 5% off. Terms apply. Many terms.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Merchant_3: Our new logo has more stars. That means quality.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Martial_0: Drill completed in 4 minutes flat. The enemy would have had no chance. The enemy was a cardboard target.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Martial_1: Strength through discipline. Discipline through push-ups.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Martial_2: Our borders are secure. Our patience is not.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Martial_3: New warship christened today. We named it 'Diplomacy'.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Hive_0: WE HAVE OPTIMISED BREAKFAST. EFFICIENCY UP 3%. DELIGHT UNCHANGED.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Hive_1: One thought. Many minds. Today the thought was about weather.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Hive_2: Individuality detected in sector 7. Correcting gently.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Hive_3: We dreamed of the old Earth. All of us. At once. It was nice.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Glitter_0: Our medical bays now regrow limbs in under an hour. Sorry, rimworlders.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Glitter_1: Poetry festival this week. The AIs are winning again.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Glitter_2: Reminder: please don't bring muffalo through the spaceport. Again.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Glitter_3: Life here is easy. Too easy. Some of us have started breaking things on purpose.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Frontier_0: Fixed the life support with tape again. Tape is the true backbone of civilization.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Frontier_1: Grew our first tomato in vacuum soil. Named it Hope.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Frontier_2: Out here, neighbours are 2 light weeks away and still borrow your tools.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Frontier_3: Frontier life: no laws, no taxes, no hot water.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Pirate_0: Fresh loot, fresh paint, fresh ego. Good week for {FACTION_name}.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Pirate_1: Lost a ship to {COLONY_name}'s turrets. Rude. We'll be back.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Pirate_2: Boarding party recruitment open. Benefits: none. Fun: plenty.
LanguageData.RimGram_RvVoice_Pirate_3: Merchant ships of the sector, consider this your friendly reminder.
